Why pilates

Three reasons people stay with it long after the first session.

01

A stronger core

Every reformer move starts from the centre, so the core gets stronger without endless crunches.

02

Better posture

Balanced strength front and back pulls the shoulders down and the spine tall again.

03

Gentle on joints

Spring resistance loads the muscles without impact, so it suits bodies of many ages and stages.

What a session looks like

A typical reformer session, from arrival to stretch.

01

Arrive and settle

Arrive a few minutes early, change, and get set up on your reformer.

02

Warm up

Breath and gentle movement wake up the core before the work begins.

03

Reformer work

Guided sequences build strength, control, and balance on the springs.

04

Stretch and close

A long stretch finishes the session, leaving you stretched out and reset.

First visit

New to pilates? Here is all you need to know before your first session.

✓

Wear something comfortable

Workout clothes you can move and stretch in, and grip socks if you have them.

✓

Bring water

Sessions are focused work. A water bottle keeps you going to the final stretch.

✓

Tell us your level

Mention any injuries or experience when you enquire, so the right batch is confirmed for you.

For every level

Pilates meets you where you are. The right batch is confirmed when you enquire.

Beginner

Learn the reformer, the breath, and the foundations at a steady pace.

Regular

Advanced

Questions, answered

What is reformer pilates?

Reformer pilates uses a sliding carriage with spring resistance. The springs support you and challenge you at the same time, and the instructor adjusts the resistance so movements stay controlled.

Do I need experience to start?

No. Tell the studio your level when you enquire and they will confirm the right batch for you.

What are the timings?

Batches run Monday to Saturday: mornings 7 AM to 12:30 PM and evenings 4:30 PM to 8:30 PM.

What should I bring?

Comfortable workout clothes, water, and grip socks if you have them.

How do I book a trial?

Call +91 88850 20922, email mavenstudiodepilates@gmail.com, or message @maven_studio_de_pilates on Instagram.
